'''Ishii Shrine''' (石井神社, pronounced Ishii Jinja or Iwai Jinja) refers to [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] located across Japan.

* [[Ishii Shrine (Yokote)]] - Located in [[Yokote, Akita]], [[Akita Prefecture]], in Omonogawa-cho Aizuka.
* [[Ishii Shrine (Kasama)]] - Located in [[Kasama, Ibaraki]], [[Ibaraki Prefecture]], in Ishii.
* [[Ishii Shrine (Kōtō)]] - Located in [[Kōtō|Kōtō, Tokyo]], [[Tokyo]], in Kameido.
* [[Ishii Shrine (Kashiwazaki)]] - Located in [[Kashiwazaki, Niigata]], [[Niigata Prefecture]], in Nishiyama-cho Ishiji. Designated as a [[Shikinaisha]].
* [[Iwai Shrine (Izumozaki)]] - Located in [[Izumozaki|Izumozaki, Niigata]], Niigata Prefecture.
* [[Tsunaga Shrine|Ishii Shrine (Ise)]] - Located in [[Ise, Mie]], [[Mie Prefecture]], in Uji Imazaike-cho. A subordinate shrine of [[Kōtai Jingū]] (Ise Grand Shrine).
* [[Ishii Shrine (Kyoto)]] - Located in [[Kyoto|Kyoto City]], [[Kyoto Prefecture]], in Nishikyō-ku Ōharano Ishizukuri-cho. Designated as a Shikinaisha.
